pr_body:
The mDNS probing is described in RFC 6762 chapter 8.1. The code will send an unsolicited mDNS query to network and will check if there are existing hosts with the same name. If there are, then the mDNS responder will not respond to queries it is configured to use.

Fixes #84333

This PR is still WIP and I will continue to debug and fix things:

~* Sometimes sent IPv6 mDNS query uses `::` as a source address~ Did not see this any more after recent changes, will monitor this

issue_context.title: mDNS should probe and announce on link change
issue_context.body:
The mDNS responder implemented in Zephyr responds correctly to mDNS queries, but it does not probe and announce as it should on startup and link change.

[RFC 6762 Section 8](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6762.html#section-8)  mandates that probing and announcing is done whenever network connectivity has changed in some relevant way. This is not done in Zephyr today.

Without this feature it is difficult for peers to handle changes in IP address gracefully.

review_comments: We're mixing errno and DNS error space here, in error checks below we set `DNS_EAI_SYSTEM` as a return value. Shouldn't we set errno and return DNS_EAI_SYSTEM here too?
My bad, I mixed DNS and errno space. We should just use the returned value directly, no need to do DNS_EAI_SYSTEM here.
